short.q: Explain how compound time differs from simple time.
short.model: In compound time each beat divides into three (e.g. 6/8); in simple time each beat divides into two (e.g. 3/4).
Two bars of triple time felt as three groups of two beats, creating a broadening effect.

short.q: Describe the difference between forward and reverse clave.
short.model: Forward clave begins with the bar of three hits (3–2); reverse clave begins with the bar of two hits (2–3).
